tasks.name: האיבר הרביעי
tasks.src: l=>l.length>3?l[3]:0
tasks.note: Returns the fourth element, or 0 for short lists.

tasks.name: זוגיים בפתיחה
tasks.src: l=>l.slice(0,3).filter(x=>x%2===0).length
tasks.note: Counts the even elements among the first three.

tasks.name: השינוי האחרון
tasks.src: l=>l.length>1?Math.abs(l[l.length-1]-l[l.length-2]):0
tasks.note: Returns the distance between the last two elements, or 0 for short lists.

tasks.name: שארית האורך בשלוש
tasks.src: l=>l.length%3
tasks.note: Returns the length of the list modulo 3.

tasks.name: הזוגי האחרון
tasks.src: l=>{ for(let i=l.length-1;i>=0;i--) if(l[i]%2===0) return l[i]; return 0; }
tasks.note: Returns the last even element, or 0 if none.

tasks.name: הזוגי הקטן
tasks.src: l=>{ const e=l.filter(x=>x%2===0); return e.length?Math.min(...e):0; }
tasks.note: Returns the smallest even element, or 0 if none.

tasks.name: בין 9 ל-11
tasks.src: l=>l.filter(x=>x>=9&&x<=11).length
tasks.note: Counts elements from 9 to 11.

tasks.name: סכום שלושת הראשונים
tasks.src: l=>l.slice(0,3).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)&15
tasks.note: Adds the first three elements modulo 16.

tasks.name: המקסימום מעל האחרון
tasks.src: l=>l.length?Math.max(...l)-l[l.length-1]:0
tasks.note: Returns how far the last element is below the largest one, or 0 when empty.

tasks.name: שיא החצי הראשון
tasks.src: l=>{ const h=l.slice(0,l.length>>1); return h.length?Math.max(...h):0; }
tasks.note: Returns the largest element of the front half (without the middle element of an odd list), or 0 when it is empty.

tasks.name: זוגיים מאחרים
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length;j++) if(l[i]%2&&l[j]%2===0) c++; return Math.min(15,c); }
tasks.note: Counts the pairs in which an odd element comes before an even one, capped at 15.

tasks.name: מעל שני הקצוות
tasks.src: l=>l.length?l.filter(x=>x>l[0]&&x>l[l.length-1]).length:0
tasks.note: Counts the elements larger than both the first and the last element.

tasks.name: סכומים רצים זוגיים
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0, c=0; for(const x of l){ s+=x; if(s%2===0) c++; } return c; }
tasks.note: Counts the prefixes (from the first element on) whose sum is even.

tasks.name: זוגות מעורבים
tasks.src: l=>{ const e=l.filter(x=>x%2===0).length; return Math.min(15,e*(l.length-e)); }
tasks.note: Counts the pairs made of one even and one odd element, capped at 15.

tasks.name: מקום החציון
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 15; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return l.indexOf(s[(l.length-1)>>1]); }
tasks.note: Returns the position in the list of its lower median value, or 15 when empty.

tasks.name: עודף מעל הקטן
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const m=Math.min(...l); return Math.min(15,l.reduce((a,x)=>a+x-m,0)); }
tasks.note: Adds up how far each element is above the smallest one, capped at 15.

tasks.name: הפער הגדול בממוין
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); let g=0; for(let i=1;i<s.length;i++) g=Math.max(g,s[i]-s[i-1]); return g; }
tasks.note: Sorts the values and returns the largest gap between neighbours, or 0 for short lists.

tasks.name: מאזן זוגיים
tasks.src: l=>Math.min(15,Math.abs(l.reduce((a,x)=>x%2?a-x:a+x,0)))
tasks.note: Returns the distance between the sum of the even elements and the sum of the odd ones, capped at 15.

tasks.name: עולים מעל שניים לפניהם
tasks.src: l=>l.filter((x,i)=>i>1&&x>l[i-2]).length
tasks.note: Counts elements larger than the element two places before them.

tasks.name: טווח הזוגיים
tasks.src: l=>{ const i=l.findIndex(x=>x%2===0); if(i<0) return 0; let j=l.length-1; while(l[j]%2) j--; return j-i; }
tasks.note: Returns how many places apart the first and last even elements are, or 0 when there is no even element.

tasks.name: מקום הזוג הקרוב
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return 15; let b=0; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if(Math.abs(l[i+1]-l[i])<Math.abs(l[b+1]-l[b])) b=i; return b; }
tasks.note: Returns the start position of the neighbouring pair with the smallest difference (the first on ties), or 15 for short lists.

tasks.name: ממוצע החצי השני
tasks.src: l=>{ const h=l.slice(l.length>>1); return h.length?Math.floor(h.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/h.length):0; }
tasks.note: Returns the average of the back half (with the middle element of an odd list) rounded down, or 0 when empty.

tasks.name: ציר חציוני
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const w=[l[0],l[l.length>>1],l[l.length-1]].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return w[1]; }
tasks.note: Returns the median of the first, middle (position half the length) and last elements, or 0 when empty.

tasks.name: החלון הקצר לשלושים
tasks.src: l=>{ let b=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++){ let s=0; for(let j=i;j<l.length;j++){ s+=l[j]; if(s>=30){ if(!b||j-i+1<b) b=j-i+1; break; } } } return b; }
tasks.note: Returns the length of the shortest contiguous stretch whose sum is at least 30, or 0 if there is none.

tasks.name: שתי עסקאות
tasks.src: l=>{ const p=a=>{ let m=99, r=0; for(const x of a){ m=Math.min(m,x); r=Math.max(r,x-m); } return r; }; let best=0; for(let k=0;k<=l.length;k++) best=Math.max(best,p(l.slice(0,k))+p(l.slice(k))); return best; }
tasks.note: Buys and sells at most twice (never holding two at once) at the listed prices and returns the largest total profit.

tasks.name: ספירת העולות הארוכות
tasks.src: l=>{ const n=l.length, L=[], C=[]; let m=0, t=0; for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ L[i]=1; C[i]=1; for(let j=0;j<i;j++) if(l[j]<l[i]){ if(L[j]+1>L[i]){ L[i]=L[j]+1; C[i]=C[j]; } else if(L[j]+1===L[i]) C[i]+=C[j]; } m=Math.max(m,L[i]); } for(let i=0;i<n;i++) if(L[i]===m) t+=C[i]; return Math.min(15,t); }
tasks.note: Counts the longest increasing subsequences (not necessarily contiguous), capped at 15; 0 when empty.

tasks.name: ימי המתנה לחום
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length;j++) if(l[j]>l[i]){ s+=j-i; break; } return Math.min(15,s); }
tasks.note: For each element finds how many places later the next larger element comes (0 when none) and returns the total, capped at 15.

tasks.name: היפוכי מחבת
tasks.src: l=>{ const a=[...l]; let c=0; for(let n=a.length;n>1;n--){ const m=a.indexOf(Math.max(...a.slice(0,n))); if(m===n-1) continue; if(m>0){ a.splice(0,m+1,...a.slice(0,m+1).reverse()); c++; } a.splice(0,n,...a.slice(0,n).reverse()); c++; } return c; }
tasks.note: Sorts by pancake flips (bring the largest unsorted element to the front with a prefix reversal, then flip it into place, skipping flips that are not needed) and counts the flips.

tasks.name: ארגזים ברצף
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0, s=0; for(const x of l){ if(!c||s+x>30){ c++; s=x; } else s+=x; } return c; }
tasks.note: Packs the elements in order into boxes of capacity 30, opening a new box whenever the next element does not fit, and returns the number of boxes.

tasks.name: קטעים שמתחילים במינימום
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length&&l[j]>l[i];j++) c++; return Math.min(15,c); }
tasks.note: Counts the contiguous stretches of two or more elements whose first element is their smallest, capped at 15.

tasks.name: זוגות שרואים
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length;j++){ let ok=true; for(let k=i+1;k<j;k++) if(l[k]>=Math.min(l[i],l[j])) ok=false; if(ok) c++; } return Math.min(15,c); }
tasks.note: Counts the pairs of elements with nothing between them as tall as the shorter of the two, capped at 15.

tasks.name: שרשרת קרובים
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const r=[true]; let c=1; for(let j=1;j<l.length;j++){ r[j]=false; for(let i=0;i<j;i++) if(r[i]&&Math.abs(l[j]-l[i])<=2){ r[j]=true; break; } if(r[j]) c++; } return c; }
tasks.note: Starting at the first element, may step forward to any later element whose value differs by at most 2; counts the elements that can be reached (the start included).

tasks.name: תת-סדרה בצעד קבוע
tasks.src: l=>{ const n=l.length; if(n<3) return n; let b=2; for(let i=0;i<n;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<n;j++){ const d=l[j]-l[i]; let c=2, last=l[j]; for(let k=j+1;k<n;k++) if(l[k]-last===d){ c++; last=l[k]; } b=Math.max(b,c); } return b; }
tasks.note: Returns the length of the longest subsequence (not necessarily contiguous) whose steps are all equal.
